title: Doors v3 — the door in your pocket

sections.text: Every Thanksgiving, they ask what college. Nobody shows you these.
Selling online, freelancing, reselling sneakers, making content, that clothing brand you wanted to start and a hundred more nobody told you about.
People call these ridiculous, right up until somebody actually pulls it off.
Most of these doors never ask for your GPA and you don't even need to know what you want yet.
Right now, someone your age is starting a brand from their bedroom with a phone and Wi-Fi. So why can't it be you?
College isn't bad. It's just not the only door. And the one in your pocket? It's already open. So why are you still standing in the hallway?
